title: colpodium minutum
intro: Colpodium minutum, commonly known as Red-stemmed Colpodium, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of respiratory conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Colpodium minutum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and cough. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
